notes: MUSEGODToken (src/MUSEGODToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments: it mints all 1,000,000,000 MUSEGOD (1e27 minor units, 18 decimals) to its deployer, the launch factory, once. The factory sends the swarm's 10% through the launch's Merkle distributor, seeds 90% into the MUSEGOD/IMD Uniswap v4 pool and forwards any remainder to remainderTo. A fixed 2% fee (BUY_FEE_BPS = 200, rounded down per transfer) is taken only on transfers whose sender is the PoolManager constant 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, including transferFrom with that sender; the fee goes to the immutable treasury constant 0x9cf1a7cd2a2a423d7df0d9663e0092423993389a and totalFeesCollected() reports the lifetime total in minor units. Transfers to the PoolManager (seeding and sells), distributor claims and user-to-user transfers pay no fee. The token cannot see PoolManager-internal accounting: a buy kept as an ERC-6909 claim pays the fee only when withdrawn as ERC-20. There is no owner, admin, pause, blacklist, mint or burn; every parameter is a compile-time constant; no selfdestruct, delegatecall or proxy. No application contracts. pool.fee 12500 is the launch policy's LP fee. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply using the deployed currency order.
